card.name: Historical first names before surnames
card.fires_on: Responds to a first name or name part of a historical person (e.g. Ninian, Elias, Levi, Increase) just before the surname in history or genealogy text. Also fires inside multi-part names like La Salle or Melancton.

modes.description: An older given name appears right before the family name of a historical figure.
